tagline: Household wellness, made in Indonesia since 1948.
eyebrow: Menthol, oils, balms and traditional wellness

story.title: A familiar Indonesian medicine cabinet, scaled into manufacturing.
story.body: Dragon Prima Farma began with menthol products and expanded into eucalyptus oil, telon oil, massage oil, balm, aromatherapy and medicated powder. The company emphasizes herbal ingredients, regulated production, quality control and openness to domestic, maklon and export cooperation.

highlights.title: Balm heritage
highlights.body: Balsem Otot, Hijau and Kuning are part of a long-running topical wellness portfolio.

highlights.title: Natural oil portfolio
highlights.body: Eucalyptus, citronella, telon and massage oils extend the Dragon household wellness range.

highlights.title: Quality + compliance
highlights.body: The company highlights R&D, QC and national certification as foundations of product consistency.

highlights.title: B2B ready
highlights.body: Dragon publicly welcomes national maklon, bulk purchase and international export cooperation.
